LegacyLineage.description:
Read from a legacy archive object. What it lacks is ``Unknown`` on the
record; layer 3 labels anything it derives from it as legacy-derived.

row_index.description: Position of the row in that object; null when it holds one.
row_index.title: Row Index

source_key.description: The legacy object the record came from.
source_key.title: Source Key

LegacyLineage.title: LegacyLineage

LegacyPeriod.description:
The UTC days from ``start`` for which a legacy archive stands in for
the recorder's records. Date-granular: when ``end`` is set, the archive
stops at the recorder cutover, 2026-10-21T04:00:00Z, on the day before
``end``.

anyOf.description: ISO date of a UTC calendar day (never a service day).

end.description: Exclusive: the first UTC day the archive no longer covers at all; it stops at the recorder cutover (2026-10-21T04:00:00Z) on the day before. Null for records the recorder does not write.
end.title: End

start.description: First UTC day the legacy archive covers.
start.title: Start

LegacyPeriod.title: LegacyPeriod

observed_at.description: The invocation's wall clock (not the cron minute).
observed_at.title: Observed At

write_failures.description: Failed writes per kind; {} = a clean tick.
